description: EE1: Stance Change does nothing for a transformed Pokemon (`attacker.transformed`). Setup: Ditto (Limber, Choice Scarf: faster than Aegislash once transformed; the lock on Transform ends as it no longer knows it) transforms into Aegislash (Shield Forme) while Aegislash uses King's Shield. The turn: the transformed Ditto's copied Shadow Claw hits Garchomp from Aegislash's Shield Forme stats it copied (no Blade Forme), while Aegislash itself Swords Dances.
